$comment: BR-6001 bridge bearings and expansion joints twin. Expected movements, gaps, strains and wear in Maximo Monitor from the design data; the loggers send only what they measure.

twin.name: Road bridge BR-6001: bearings, expansion joints and deck

identification.model: TENSA MODULAR LR 3 joint (3-span composite girder bridge)
identification.description: Road bridge, 3 continuous spans 60 + 80 + 60 m, steel-concrete composite girders: bearings, expansion joints and deck strain
identification.structure: Two steel plate girders with a concrete deck slab, continuous over 4 supports (A1, P1, P2, A2)
identification.bearings: Pot bearings: fixed (TF) on pier P1; guided sliding (TE), PTFE on stainless steel, on A1, P2 and A2
identification.joint_a1: Single-gap strip seal joint at abutment A1
identification.joint_a2: Modular expansion joint, 3 gaps, at abutment A2 (for example mageba TENSA MODULAR LR 3)
identification.monitoring: Data loggers with displacement transducers, tiltmeter, temperature probes and strain gauges; a weigh-in-motion (WIM) station on the approach

geometry.source: Spans and the position of the fixed bearing: assumption: typical value, replace with the design report / bearing and joint schedules of your bridge. Expansion length = distance from the fixed bearing on P1.

thermal.source: alpha = 12e-6 /K for the change in length of a composite bridge (EN 1994-2 5.4.2.5, as quoted in SCI P406). T0 = 10 C, the value EN 1991-1-5 gives when no other information is available (here also the bearing setting temperature). Te,min / Te,max of the site (national maps of EN 1991-1-5) and the weighting of slab and girder probes into the effective (uniform) bridge temperature: assumption: typical value, replace with the design report / bearing and joint schedules of your bridge

joints.source: TENSA MODULAR LR 3: 3 gaps, 240 mm longitudinal movement, each gap up to 80 mm (mageba brochure). Total gap at T0, single-gap joint size and the 5 mm minimum gap (lamellas about to touch): assumption: typical value, replace with the design report / bearing and joint schedules of your bridge

bearing_p2.source: Friction of PTFE on austenitic steel 2.0 to 3.0 %, maximum 3 %, and 10 km accumulated sliding path for PTFE to EN 1337-2 (mageba ROBO SLIDE 75 brochure; 10 km at 400 m/year = the 25 years it quotes for PTFE). Permanent load per bearing, pier height and stiffness, PTFE protrusion when new, wear per km of path and the design path rate (thermal + traffic micro-movements): assumption: typical value, replace with the design report / bearing and joint schedules of your bridge. Pier head tilt = 1.5 x head displacement / height (cantilever with a load at the top).

deck.source: Peak strain at the span 2 midspan bottom flange per kN of vehicle gross weight in the slow lane (influence coefficient from the bridge model, calibrated by a load test) and the static strain per K of slab-to-girder temperature difference: assumption: typical value, replace with the design report / bearing and joint schedules of your bridge. Legal gross weight 44 t: assumption, replace with your national limit.

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 60 times faster (one bridge day in 24 minutes) on a summer day. A seized bearing has been stuck since the winter (Te 2 C) and a blocked joint since the spring (Te 12 C), so the residuals show at once.

groups.Temperature: Deck slab, girder and air temperature

points.label: Bearing P2 sliding displacement from its set position (+ = away from P1)
Bearing P2 accumulated sliding path since installation
Bearing P2 sliding path over the last 365 days
Bearing A2 sliding displacement from its set position (+ = away from P1)
Pier P2 head tilt along the bridge
Joint A2 lamella peak vertical acceleration under traffic, last 10 min
Span 2 bottom flange static strain (temperature compensated, traffic filtered)
Span 2 bottom flange peak strain under the last heavy vehicle
Gross weight of the last heavy vehicle (slow lane)

limits.source: Alert limits: assumption: typical value, replace with the design report / bearing and joint schedules of your bridge; the friction limit is the 3 % maximum for PTFE (bearing_p2.mu_max).

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

bearing_seized.name: Sliding bearing P2 seized (corrosion, debris, displaced PTFE)
bearing_seized.symptoms: bearing P2 stops following the temperature; the deck drags the pier head: tilt and friction estimate jump

ptfe_wear.name: PTFE sliding sheet worn (end of life)
ptfe_wear.symptoms: PTFE protrusion below its limit, friction above 3 %, the bearing still moves

sliding_path_fast.name: Sliding path growing fast (traffic micro-movements, loose guide)
sliding_path_fast.symptoms: path over the last 365 days well above design; remaining wear life short

joint_blocked.name: Expansion joint A2 blocked (debris, end of travel)
joint_blocked.symptoms: joint does not close as the deck warms; compressive restraint strain in the deck

joint_control_failure.name: Modular joint control springs failed
joint_control_failure.symptoms: gaps no longer equal, one gap closed and lamellas hammering under traffic

girder_stiffness_loss.name: Girder stiffness loss (shear connectors, cracking)
girder_stiffness_loss.symptoms: more strain per kN of vehicle weight than the model

overweight_traffic.name: Overweight traffic
overweight_traffic.symptoms: many vehicles above the legal weight; strain per kN normal

displacement_sensor.name: Displacement transducer drift at A2
displacement_sensor.symptoms: joint gap and bearing movement at A2 no longer add up
